'Springbank' is a superb four-bedroom family home extending to approximately 189.6 sq m, presented in excellent walk-in condition throughout, set amidst the peaceful and picturesque surroundings of Tara Hill and offering the perfect blend of space, comfort, and convenience. Situated on circa 0.74acres, the property provides a wonderful sense of privacy while still being within close proximity to Kilgorman Strand, Clone and Saleen beaches, Gorey town and renowned golf courses as well as walking distance to Tara Hill School.

The interior is bright and welcoming, with thoughtfully designed living spaces that flow effortlessly and provide both comfort and practicality. The spacious well laid out accommodation briefly consists of entrance hallway, living room, kitchen, office, four generously-sized bedrooms, master bedroom with ensuite, bathroom and guest wc.

Outside, the grounds are mature and private, offering plenty of space for outdoor enjoyment. A detached block-built garage and an Adman steel shed provide excellent storage or workshop potential.

Enjoying a tranquil countryside setting while remaining convenient to coastal amenities, local services to include National School, Coffee Shop, Castletown GAA Sports Complex, Church and nearby towns of Gorey and Arklow. 

Springbank combines space, presentation and location in a highly desirable package. This is a rare opportunity to acquire a turnkey home close to one of County Wexford’s most beautiful beaches.  Viewing is highly recommended to experience this idyllic lifestyle.

.
